text.p: Porto of Portugal and England's Manchester United drew 0-0 in their European Cup quarter-final second leg match on Wednesday.

Porto - 1-Andrezej Wosniak; 2-Joao Pinto (25-Zlatko Zahovic 37), 3-Rui Jorge, 20-Paulinho Santos, 5-Fernando Mendes (27- Gzegorzs Mielcarski 50), 22-Jorge Costa, 19-Joao Manuel Pinto, 17-Jose Barroso (26-Arnold Wetl 48), 21-Edmilson Pimenta, 11-Ljubimko Drulovic, 16-Mario Jardel,

Manchester United - 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 4-David May, 6-Gary Pallister, 3-Denis Irwin (15 Karel Poborsky 80), 10-David Beckham (28 Phil Neville 80), 5-Ronny Johnsen, 7-Eric Cantona, 8-Nicky Butt, 16-Roy Keany, 20-Ole Gunnar Solskjaer (12-Paul Scholles 69).
